title: LinkSea
subtitle: Rebuilding the student side of a school platform, and testing it with the students.
description: Zoe Zhou's case study on rebuilding the student interface of a school workflow platform used daily at a middle school in Hong Kong.

sections.heading: The question
sections.body: A school platform is used every day, by people who did not choose it and cannot route around it. The students were the group with the least say in it and the most exposure to it.
sections.editorTodo: Replace with the specific navigation or workflow problem you were handed, 100–150 words. What were students failing to do?

sections.heading: Context and constraints
sections.body: A middle school in Hong Kong. The platform carries three interfaces, for students, teachers and administrators; the student one was mine. It was already in daily use, so the rebuild had to land inside something people depended on.
sections.editorTodo: Confirm what is shareable about the school and the platform before this goes public. Add year group, rough number of students, and anything about the device or network conditions.

sections.heading: What I made
sections.body: The student-facing interface, built in JavaScript.

sections.heading: What changed
sections.body: I tested with the students themselves and rebuilt the parts they could not complete.
